owner_authority: Owner approved audit route steps1/2 within150minutes, and one conditional step3 within120minutes; original elapsed time and zero-new-acquisition floor retained.

consumer.actor: research analyst reviewing a daily breakout follow-up list
consumer.action: choose at most five T-close episode alerts to inspect; distinguish probe, acceptance, invalid/uncertain
consumer.claim_ceiling: Research triage only; no investor return, live analyst time saving or historical-as-known claim.

shared_inputs: same exact context universe and UNKNOWN denominator
comparison.baseline: existing frozen R0, no deliberately weakened or information-deprived baseline

ranking_before_reference.unknown: retained in denominator and unselected; not negative

comparison.useful_only_if: at same cost fewer false alerts with no lost definite positives, or more definite positives with no extra false alerts; no claim if neither strictly improves
comparison.uncertainty: paired issuer-cluster summaries; dependent episodes/scales are not independent votes

sampling_preflight.source_scope: only previously admitted2021 prefixes and already authorized identity/calendar metadata

reference.old_tier_ceiling: deterministic rule shadow and reproducibility only; not human or new independent AI review
reference.purpose_requires: candidate-blind separately attributable semantic judgements on same T-only packets, independent of compared threshold rules as sole truth

step3_requires: qualified exact new input and complete hashes
execution.when_unmet: record exact NO_GO and NOT_RUN, preserve reusable code and qualified facts; no automatic resampling or extra round
